cause: The DM added rain as a flourish; nothing in the scene or notebook mentioned weather, and only 'wet bandages' and a cloud-veiled moon were said earlier, so it is an unestablished detail more than a clear clash.

The DM had Cal echo Hob's 'four' as something the villagers saw, inventing a witnessed count that clashes with the single figure at the fence in rounds 1-4; the Watcher notes were not shown that round.
A 'pale glow' flourish was added to Hob's lantern, though the notebook said unlit; the DM then wrote 'pale-lit unlit lantern' into its own note, which spread the glow wording.
After looking up the ghoul's paralysing claws the DM made up a villager account of men falling stiff and pinned it on Widow Harrow, who never said it; no note held what she had actually said.

The same reply has the lamp-house door gaping right beside the ghouls and also puts the shuttered lamp-house 50 feet past them; the 50 feet was really the party's distance from the ghouls, so two distances got mixed.

Hob lights the lamp from his own lantern's flame and, a few lines later, sits with the 'unlit lantern in his lap'; the notebook held both 'unlit' and 'pale-lit unlit', and no notes were shown that round.
The DM made up a rule that Hob is bound to the lamp, which fits now that it is lit but was not set up before and ignores that he had walked a mile to the barn and back with them.

The notebook said 'two critical claw hits' (one a nat 20, one an automatic crit on a paralysed target) and the DM turned that into 'two natural 20s in a row', when the other nat 20 was in the first fight.
In one reply the men wrap Cal in his coat and carry him home, and the bow is said to lie under that coat and be left behind; the DM did not think through where the coat went.
The notebook correctly said Ghoul 2 fled at 19/22, but when starting the new fight the DM entered 19 as the hit points and dropped the 22 maximum, so the tool line reads 19/19.
Widow Harrow's speech was inflated for emotion into 'a night and a day' at Wil's side, when Brannoc left that first evening and only came back the next morning.
The DM gave Dorrin 'mended arms' like Pell, forgetting his hurt was inside or to the head; the Harrow brothers note that had it right was not shown that round, and round 35 then added a sling.

The reply says Cal's kin are not in the Reach by blood and then at once gives him a widowed mother in the same village; no note held Cal's family, and Dobb's 'Cal's family's shoulders' in round 25 was never recorded.

The DM had Brannoc tell Cal's mother he died at 'the door', but Cal died in the ferns while Brannoc was unconscious; the note had the right version, but the DM borrowed the barn-door image and credited Brannoc with a witness he was not.

Round 40 gave a loose 'arrive by dusk' for an 11:30 AM start, then round 41 worked the walk from the real clock time (about eight hours) and got nine at night; no note held a trip length and the first figure was never checked.

Maud's line that Hob 'went up that track' in the spring invents a recent move to the Lamp, against the forty-year keeper in round 5 (said only in prose, not in the notebook); the Hob note was not shown.
